newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton in talks with PBL on casino.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton in talks with PBL on casino.

text.p: Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had had discussions with media magnate Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd (PBL) about its investment in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd.

Asked if there had been any pressure from PBL for Leighton to sell its five percent stake in the casino, Leighton's managing director, Wal King said: "There have been discussions with PBL but those discussions are confidential."
"We think PBL can enhance the casino in the operations and performance. If any enhancement materialises, we want to share in it," he said.
In mid-January, PBL said it would buy 10 percent of the shares of Sydney Harbour Casino from Showboat Inc and take management control of the casino facility.

PBL also granted Showboat a put option to sell about another 10 percent of Sydney Harbour Casino stock to PBL by March 1999. Asked if the company would hold onto its Sydney Harbour Casino stake for much longer, King said, "We have no aspiration to run or be long-term investors in a casino as any other major infrastructure project that we facilitate."
"When the project is up and running and we believe that the potential and the return is at the optimal level then we will exist the project," King said.
King said there were lots of bullish predictions about the Sydney Harbour Casino stock and the company was looking at that and would make its own judgement.
At 12.25 p.m. (0125 GMT), Sydney Harbour Casino shares were six cents weaker at A$2.29 on turnover of 27.09 million shares, while Leighton shares were seven cents weaker at A$5.78.
